exercise_plan.name: Resistance Training
exercise_plan.description: Focused on overall muscle development. You can do this in the gym or home with the help of weights or bodyweight exercises.

exercise_plan.name: Cardiovascular Activity
exercise_plan.description: Include light to moderate cardio (like 20 mins of brisk walking) to keep your heart healthy and manage body fat level.

diet_plan.description: A serving of Idly with Sambar - Rich in complex carbohydrates, protein and fiber, this dish will give you energy and keep you full.
Brown rice with fish curry - Brown rice is high in fiber, and fish is rich in high-quality protein.
Whole wheat Chapathi with Dal and salad - High in fiber and protein, this meal is ideal for muscle recovery and growth.
